description: Standard public descriptions shared by the CLI, SDKs, and integrations.

url.name: url
url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL of the page to process.

prompt.name: prompt
prompt.description: Instructions describing the data to extract. Append Json Schema: and a JSON schema to shape the output.
prompt.default: Extract all data as complete as possible.

html.name: html
html.description: Whether to include the page HTML in the response.

browserRendering.name: browserRendering
browserRendering.description: Whether to load the page in a browser: true always does and false never does. Omit it to load the page without a browser first and switch to a browser automatically if the request is blocked.

timeout.name: timeout
timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the scrape, from 1 to 330. The HTTP request allows 30 additional seconds.

warmStart.name: warmStart
warmStart.description: Whether to open the site's home page first to warm the session before loading the target URL.

blockResources.name: blockResources
blockResources.description: Whether to block images, fonts, and stylesheets while loading the page.

waitForSelector.name: waitForSelector
waitForSelector.description: CSS selector or text to wait for on the page before returning the result, up to 500 characters.

action.name: action
action.description: Scraper action that routes the request or simply flags it, useful for separating analytics per domain.

geoCode.name: geoCode
geoCode.description: Two-letter country code to load the page from, sent in lowercase.

maxAge.name: maxAge
maxAge.description: Return a cached result of the same request when it is newer than the selected age. A cached result costs the same tokens as the original scrape.

maxRetries.name: maxRetries
maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries, as a nonnegative integer. Omit this parameter for no limit.

screenshotCapture.name: screenshot
screenshotCapture.description: Screenshot to capture with the HTML: false for none, full for the entire page, top for the first viewport, or a WIDTHxHEIGHT viewport from 100 to 3840 pixels with an optional -ZOOM percent from 25 to 300, such as 1280x800 or 1920x1080-75. Setting a screenshot also sends browserRendering=true.

screenshotArea.name: screenshot
screenshotArea.description: Screenshot area to capture: full for the entire scroll height, top for the first viewport, or a WIDTHxHEIGHT viewport from 100 to 3840 pixels with an optional -ZOOM percent from 25 to 300, such as 1280x800 or 1920x1080-75.

includeScreenshot.name: screenshot
includeScreenshot.description: Whether to include a base64 screenshot in the response.

query.name: query
query.description: Search query text, trimmed before sending, containing 1 to 1000 characters.

country.name: country
country.description: Two-letter country code to search from, sent in lowercase.

numResults.name: numResults
numResults.description: Number of search results to request, as an integer from 10 to 100. Fewer results may be returned.

token.name: token
token.description: API key used to authenticate the request.

services.name: status
services.title: Status
services.description: Return the raw account status API response without summarizing, redacting body fields, or adding calculated fields.
services.response: The API body contains message and data. Account details remain nested in data, including subscriptionItem and scraperAllowance. The response envelope therefore exposes account details at data.data. Sensitive response headers are removed.

services.name: scrape-html
services.title: Scrape HTML
services.description: Retrieve the raw HTML of a page. Browser rendering is optional.
services.response: The response body is HTML text. With a screenshot, the API returns JSON containing html and a base64 screenshot.

services.name: scrape-markdown
services.title: Scrape Markdown
services.description: Retrieve a page as clean Markdown. Browser rendering is optional.
services.response: The response body is Markdown text.

services.name: get-screenshot
services.title: Get screenshot
services.description: Capture a base64 PNG screenshot of the full page, the first viewport, or a custom viewport. Browser rendering is always enabled.
services.response: The response body is JSON containing a base64 PNG screenshot and the page HTML, which the API includes even though html=false is sent.

services.name: scrape-brand
services.title: Scrape brand
services.description: Extract a website's colors, typography, logos, and social links as JSON.
services.response: The API body contains message and a data object with job_id, status, url, final_url, brand, and error. Brand details are available at data.data.brand in the response envelope.

services.name: scrape-json
services.title: Scrape JSON
services.description: Extract structured JSON from a page using a natural-language prompt. Append Json Schema: and a JSON schema to shape the output.
services.response: Extraction results are in the API body's data field and follow the requested schema. Response metadata includes thread_id, token_usage, status, error, runtime, and cookies. html contains the page HTML unless disabled; markdown and screenshot can be empty strings.

services.name: web-search
services.title: Web search
services.description: Search the web and return ranked results with titles, URLs, descriptions, and sources.
services.response: The API body contains success, message, a data array, and tokenUsage. Each result includes rank, title, url, description, and source.

response_examples_note: Response examples show selected keys and types observed in live API responses. Values are placeholders; page content, base64 images, and arrays are abbreviated. Actual responses may contain additional fields.
